content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Hyderabad Post-Doctoral Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 09-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Hyderabad Post-Doctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 09 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Post-Doctoral Fellow role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in Chemical Engineering, Material Science, Chemistry, or Physics to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position at IIT Hyderabad.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 58,000 to Rs. 67,000, along with 30% HRA as per DST norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is through email. Candidates need to send their complete application and required documents via email.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Post-Doctoral Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves application evaluation, shortlisting, an online interview, and finally, a recommendation from the selection committee.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIT Hyderabad located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad is located in Hyderabad, Telangana, with the pincode 502284.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this Post-Doctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: The Post-Doctoral Fellow position is a contractual role at IIT Hyderabad.

faq.question: Q10. When is the tentative interview date for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: The tentative interview dates are scheduled for the 4th week of September 2026.
